newsitem.title: USA: Corrections Corp to build Miss. prison.
newsitem.headline: Corrections Corp to build Miss. prison.

text.p: Corrections Corp of America said on Friday that it has agreed to build and run a 500-cell medium-security prison in Wilkinson County, Mississippi.

The prison's $35 million in construction costs would be financed by the state of Mississippi using tax-exempt bonds, the company said. Corrections Corp said the prison would generate about $5.5 million in annual revenues.
It was scheduled to be completed in February 1998, the company said.
